REASONS FOR AMENDMENT AND MAIN CONTENTS

[Partial amendment]

◇ Reasons for amendment

The amendment is intended to disperse and reallocate functions and powers concentrated in particular ministries, address concerns about the concentration of authority, and strengthen the expertise specific to each function; redesign the organizational structure of the Government so that it can respond actively to changes in the administrative environment, including the climate crisis and the major transition involving artificial intelligence; readjust the deputy prime minister system and the system of ministries under the Prime Minister to strengthen capabilities in science and technology, artificial intelligence, national data administration, and intellectual property administration; and strengthen government functions so that gender equality policies and occupational safety and health policies can be actively pursued.

◇ Main contents

(a) Abolish the Broadcasting and Communications Commission, establish the Broadcasting, Media and Communications Commission, and transfer affairs relating to the promotion of broadcasting currently performed by the Ministry of Science and ICT to the Broadcasting, Media and Communications Commission (Articles 2(2)1 and 31).

(b) Establish two deputy prime ministers to exercise overall supervision and coordination over economic policy and science, technology, and artificial intelligence policy, with those offices concurrently held by the Minister of Finance and Economy and the Minister of Science and ICT, respectively, while abolishing the office of deputy prime minister concurrently held by the Minister of Education (Article 19).

(c) Separate the Ministry of Economy and Finance into the Ministry of Planning and Budget under the Prime Minister and the Ministry of Finance and Economy in order to ensure mutual checks and balances between budgetary and economic functions and strengthen the expertise of each function (newly established Article 23 and Article 30).

(d) Elevate Statistics Korea and the Korean Intellectual Property Office to the National Data Office and the Intellectual Property Office under the Prime Minister, respectively (newly established Articles 27 and 28).

(e) Adjust the order of the executive ministries following the reorganization of the deputy prime ministers and executive ministries, and provide for two vice ministers each in the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Ministry of SMEs and Startups (Article 29).

(f) Abolish the Prosecutors' Office and establish a Public Prosecution Office under the Minister of Justice and a Serious Crime Investigation Office under the Minister of the Interior and Safety, respectively, in order to establish a system that enables mutual checks between investigative and prosecutorial agencies (Articles 35 and 37).

(g) Reorganize the Ministry of Environment as the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and transfer the energy affairs of the existing Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy (excluding the export sector for nuclear power generation) to the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment so that environmental, climate change, and energy policies can be pursued in an interconnected and integrated manner; and reorganize the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy as the Ministry of Trade and Industry to reflect the transfer of energy affairs (Articles 41 and 43).

(h) Establish one head of headquarters responsible for occupational safety and health affairs in the Ministry of Employment and Labor, with that head being a public official in political service (newly established Article 44(2)).

(i) Rename the Ministry of Women and Family as the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family in order to pursue gender equality policies comprehensively, and expand and reorganize it, including by transferring certain related affairs of the Ministry of Employment and Labor to the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family (Article 45 and Article 2(1) of the Addenda).
